name: Differentiable Primitive Assembly
definition: A method modeling 3D shapes as an assembly of quadric primitives using differentiable intersection and union operations, trained with image-space losses only without 3D supervision.
summary: Differentiable Primitive Assembly models 3D shapes as learnable quadric primitives combined via differentiable set operations, distinguishing itself from Gaussian Splatting by using algebraic surfaces and Boolean CSG.
